description: Geeky Orchestration plugin hooks: guard edits to frozen planning artifacts. Default mode is warn (advisory, surfaced through portable stdout+stderr). For a hard block, append -Mode block (emits Claude/Codex deny JSON). The hook runs the PowerShell guard with "shell": "powershell", so it needs PowerShell 7+ (pwsh) on PATH but not Git Bash. That lets it run where Git Bash cannot start, such as MXC sandboxes. The Python guard (hooks/guard-planning-contract.py) behaves identically; to use it, remove "shell" and set the command to: bash "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/hooks/py-run.sh" "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/hooks/guard-planning-contract.py" --mode warn
